title: Webcam side
description: Side of osu!'s layout for the webcam frame. auto = right: osu! and catch put the webcam at the top of the right band beside the playfield and the play strip at the bottom of the left band; mania puts both right of the stage; taiko puts the webcam in the bottom-right corner under the lane and the play strip on the left under the lane. left mirrors this.

title: Webcam placement follows
description: follow ruleset moves the webcam frame to each ruleset's free zone (move your OBS webcam source to match if you switch rulesets). Pick one ruleset to keep the frame still wherever you play.

title: Webcam size
description: 16:9 webcam slot: small = 320×180, medium = 384×216, large = 480×270. It shrinks to fit the free band (the osu! and catch side bands fit 336×189). The slot is transparent: place your OBS webcam source under it; alignment guides show its exact rectangle.

title: Webcam nudge X / px
description: Moves the webcam frame and its tag right (negative = left).

title: Webcam nudge Y / px
description: Moves the webcam frame and its tag down (negative = up).

title: Streamer handle
description: Name on the tag beside the webcam. Leave empty to use the osu! profile name.

title: Social text
description: Short text on the webcam tag, e.g. twitch.tv/name · x.com/name. Leave empty to hide.

title: Show live play strip
description: During gameplay: pp now and if FC, accuracy, combo, UR (misses in catch) and mods.

title: Show title and progress
description: Map title, difficulty, elapsed time and a progress line at the top of the play strip (osu! shows none of these during gameplay).

title: Text scale
description: Scale for the play strip and session ledger; clamped to 0.6–1.6.

title: Show session ledger
description: In song select and on results: plays and playtime this session, pp gained and global rank moved since this source loaded. Sits in the free centre column of song select and the right of the results header.

title: Show pp on results (stable)
description: osu!stable's results screen has no pp; this adds the result's pp and if-FC pp to the ledger. Not shown on lazer, which displays pp itself.

title: Accent
description: map = tint the highlight (pp, corner marks, progress) with a colour from the current map's background, without showing the art. 18-lab = always amber.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a soft dark field that fades out behind each text cluster (keeps text legible over bright skins and maps). none = text floats on the game with only a text shadow. panel = small graphite panels.

title: Show webcam tag
description: Handle and social text beside the webcam frame.

title: Alignment guides
description: Setup aid: labels the webcam slot with its exact pixel position and size. Turn off before going live.
